confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Sri Lankan tourist pricing, with no live listings checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the more reliable; accommodation and alcohol (high taxes, wide variation) are least certain. July coincides with the Esala Perahera festival in Kandy, which can push hotel rates up. FX: the 0.6955 figure comes from a search-result snippet attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page for 15 Oct 2026. I could not open the page to confirm it. A snippet from the RBA homepage showed 0.7002 for 14 Oct, so verify the figure on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South Asia, benchmarked against tourist-oriented Sri Lankan hill and coastal towns such as Ella and Galle, adjusted for Kandy's mid-range guesthouse and hotel stock. Beer and wine anchors use the usual local relationship: wine glass is roughly three times beer and cocktail roughly twice beer, reflecting high imported-alcohol costs.
